editorial:
Imagine finding out your husband is cheating on you with your absolute best friend. That is exactly what happens to Michelle, a fancy Beverly Hills wife who thinks she has it all. Instead of just crying or filing for divorce, she teams up with the very woman who stole her man, Allie. These two decide the best way to get over their drama is to start robbing the rich ladies who visit Allie's beauty salon. It is a wild, funny ride that turns a betrayal into a weird friendship, and the whole vibe feels like a colorful, chaotic trip through the upper class of California.

You will love how the chemistry between the two leads makes the heist scenes feel exciting and silly. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable. If you want something light and breezy for a movie night, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or if you prefer, you can rent it on Apple TV. For those who love owning their movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After a series of risky robberies, the two women realize that their bond is stronger than any grudge. They manage to outsmart the people they robbed and the law. In the final scenes, Michelle and Allie decide to leave their old lives behind entirely. They take the money they stole and escape together to start a fresh life, proving that friendship and greed can be a powerful mix. They end up happy and free.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves female-led comedies and crime capers.
